name: claude-code
description: The Claude Code plugin-authoring plugin — doctrine for writing plugins against Claude Code itself: directory-convention discovery, the invocation policy's three states and the silent failure the wrong one causes, manifest fields and the two marketplace traps, and hooks with their per-event verdict shapes. Owns the claude-code-plugin project template for vwf's `plugin` platform, so it also implements the vwf stack-adapter contract.
